_what: Luis's Burrow, pitch 07 on the Campgrounds: a cave dug in under the roots of an old tree in the wood, its floor heaped with cushions and blankets, fluffy animals curled up in it, and a telly. From Helen Edgar's brief, 2026-11-05: "create a surprise den for luis - cosy cave space in woods with fluffy animals and trees, use orange and green colours, lots of cushions and blankets, have a tv screen showing frasier youtube clips." tools/make-luis-burrow.py writes the telly and its rack into luis-burrow.html between the lbw:telly markers from this file. Do not hand-edit between the markers.
_source: Two shelves under one telly, Helen Edgar's ask, 2026-11-05: five Frasier clips at the top ("only use 5 top clips"), then the wood: animals running and playing in forests, and a waterfall. Every Frasier clip is on Paramount Plus's own YouTube channel (Paramount owns Frasier), and every animal film on BBC Earth's own; the waterfall is on Nature Zilla, the channel that filmed it. Found by searching YouTube on 2026-11-05 and read off each video's own watch page the same day with a browser's user agent, never from memory: playabilityStatus OK and playableInEmbed true for every one, available in every country YouTube lists, and the runtime from lengthSeconds. Fan uploads were left off: the maker's own uploads only, the Faery Yurt cinema's rule. The titles are the channels' own, as they wrote them, and the waterfall's channel sells it for sleep and meditation, which is its words and not this room's. tools/check-jukebox.py asks after every one. A video that stops playing is taken off the rack, never swapped for a fan copy.

_coffee: Helen's asks, 2026-11-05: a coffee machine, lots of coffee cups, freshly ground beans with a variety of intensities from around the world, free to help yourself to and pour a cup. Every bean names where it is grown, how it is roasted and how strong it is on the burrow's own scale, one to ten, which is the burrow's way of saying it and nobody's standard. The tasting words are ours, the way a bag of beans describes itself, and nothing here says what coffee does for a body. Nothing costs anything.

_books: Helen's ask, 2026-11-05: take a book from a politics, sociology, phenomenology and neurodiversity bookshelf to sit with. Every book carries a borrow link, which is an Open Library record found by searching Open Library's own API by title and author on 2026-11-05 and reading the record that came back, never an id typed from memory: the Hermitage's shelf rule, after the id there that pointed at a different book. The line under each is ours and says only what the book is. Nothing is for sale here.
